projects.name: autonomous-sdlc-harness
projects.description: An autonomous software-delivery harness: a task prompt becomes a planned, implemented, reviewed and pushed branch, driven by a fleet of single-purpose agents through plan, implement, review, interactive tests and statistics. It ships as two halves - a Claude Code plugin carrying the process assets, and a Node CLI carrying the outer loop that runs them.
